en.title: Obsession Hits Peacock July 17 After Blockbuster Run
en.summary: The surprise horror hit 'Obsession' is officially coming to streaming. Fans can expect to dive into the chilling narrative this Friday.
en.body:
The cinematic surprise of 2026, **Curry Barker**'s **Obsession**, is making its way to streaming sooner than many anticipated. After a remarkable and historic box office run that saw the film gross an astounding $400 million globally, **Peacock** has announced that **Obsession** will be available to stream starting Friday, July 17. This marks a 63-day theatrical window, a period that industry analysts speculated might be longer given the film's immense commercial success. Focus Features, which acquired North American and certain foreign rights out of TIFF Midnight for a reported $15 million, is bringing the film home to digital audiences.

Directed by **Curry Barker**, **Obsession** defied expectations as a breakout horror hit. The film centers on Bear, played by **Michael Johnston**, who purchases and breaks a peculiar toy known as the "One Wish Willow." His wish, however, comes with a dark and sinister price, transforming a seemingly simple desire into a terrifying ordeal. The film's premise, a love spell gone awry, takes a familiar concept and twists it in unexpected ways, ensuring audiences are kept on the edge of their seats. This unique approach, combined with its financial triumph, has cemented **Obsession** as one of the year's most talked-about films.

## The Fan Frenzy for 'Obsession'
The fervent fan response to **Obsession** has been palpable, with social media buzzing about its terrifying twists and masterful storytelling. Many viewers have lauded the film for its originality and its ability to deliver genuine scares while exploring complex themes of desire and consequence. The rapid move to streaming, following a brief VOD window, suggests an effort to capitalize on this widespread enthusiasm. For those who missed its theatrical run or are eager to revisit its unsettling atmosphere, the **Peacock** release offers a convenient opportunity. The film's journey from an acclaimed festival acquisition to a global box office phenomenon and now a highly anticipated streaming debut underscores its significant impact on the genre.

## What's Next for 'Obsession'
With its streaming debut on **Peacock** on July 17, **Obsession** is poised to reach an even wider audience. While details regarding international streaming availability and potential physical media releases have not yet been announced, fans can certainly expect **Curry Barker**'s directorial debut to continue generating discussion. The film's success also opens doors for potential future projects from the director and its talented cast, making it a must-watch for anyone interested in the future of horror cinema.

Peacock has confirmed that Obsession will debut on its streaming service on July 17. As mentioned above, the movie’s streaming release follows a prolonged box-office run and a delayed (and ultimately brief) VOD availability window. It’s doubtful that the movie will be available via any other streamers anytime soon, so it’s time to re-up that Peacock subscription if you don’t already have one. And if you haven’t seen Obsession … well, brace yourself. The horror film from director Curry Barker is undoubtedly one of the year’s most surprising films in ways that go beyond its incredible financial success. Essentially the tale of a love spell gone very wrong, Obsession takes a fairly familiar core premise and twists it in just the right ways to ensure that you’re never quite prepared for the places it goes. So while there’s a good chance you’ve already seen the movie based on how many people apparently have, there’s never a bad time to check out the story of a guy named Bear who speedruns through a series of bad decisions in record time.
